div.div:
Error bodies
Every error is {"erro": "…"} with a generic message, set by Gateway Responses or by the Lambda. The text is never echoed back.
Cheap rejections
403, 429 and the validator's 400 never invoke the Lambda: no Comprehend cost, and they do not count toward the kill switch.
Logging
Each request that reaches the Lambda writes one log line: status, mode, length and latency. Never the text.

• Content-Type application/json
• body is a JSON object
• texto: string, 1 to 1,000 chars
• modo: integer 1, 2 or 3
(true, "1" and 1.0 are rejected)
